decisions.reason: Retaining the current dispense-button location does not change the required spout or bowl sealing behavior.
The decision concerns the location of the spout controls, not the spout's mounting location, orientation, material, appearance, or pour direction.
The source message's separate acceptance of the bulkier machine is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event.
Button placement does not alter the requirement that the dispensing path be removable or easy to clean.
Keeping the controls in their current location does not change the liquid-containment or electrical-isolation requirement.
The source accepts an existing control location and enclosure size without changing any BOM component selection or compatibility requirement.
The candidate already specifies the current front placement of the two dispense buttons; the source retains that placement without changing its state.
The control-location decision does not alter platform height, footprint, or cup-clearance requirements.
Local context identifies the retained on/off buttons as the two spout controls, not the separate centered master power control.
Accepting the existing physical button placement does not change the wiring-plan deliverable or its electrical component requirements.
The client accepts the already-current layout rather than imposing a new CAD constraint or changing the system-layout deliverable.
Neither retention of the button location nor acceptance of the bulkier enclosure changes the established splash-control behavior.
